steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Come on, open your mouth, please? I'm just checking your teeth. I promise I won't hurt you.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Don't make me pull out the big guns every time.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Look, Miss Perro, what do I have here?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If you're a good girl and help me finish my exam....

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: These honey biscuits are all yours.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That's weird. Why isn't she reacting to the honey biscuits?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: There's something wrong with your recipe, Hibiscus.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: How many times have I told you not to put weird stuff in your food?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Here, little Perro, I'll give you this.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But you have to be a good girl.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That's my little Lava. So reliable.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Okay, let's proceed with the oral exam.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Swallow the crumbs, okay, and open wide...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Watch your tongue, Miss Perro——Hm, what?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Why did we bring her back with us?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Because we felt bad for her. Her infection is very serious.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And the head of the Leithanian branch even said:

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: 'It's a good thing you subdued her. There would have been no hope for her if the police or bounty hunters found her first.'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: An Infected person as far gone as her, with the way the laws in Leithanien have changed, almost certainly would have been euthanized.'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If it's at all possible, please at least get her out of Leithanien's territory. Thank you.'

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Even if she wasn't Infected, the way she was just attacking people on the road would probably not have ended well for her.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: At least twenty-four groups of travelers got attacked before us. She hurt nearly a hundred people.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And that's just in Leithanien. Who knows what she did anywhere else.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Not to mention her fighting skills. I don't think the five of us could've pulled off attacks like that.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But all she did was take some food. She was just hungry——Ow!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: If Kroos wasn't looking out for me and Beagle wasn't so quick with her shield, this Perro would've crushed your little sister with that rock-covered javelin.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Miss Perro, please don't bite my hand!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Your teeth are almost finished. Just a little longer. Hang in there!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Come on, Lava, don't be like that.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Like what? I'm just stating facts.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What's with you all of a sudden? Getting pissy about every little thing.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I thought you loved Miss Perro?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Yeah, she's great. She loves me too.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That's why she threw all kinds of rocks and flames and ice and pretty much everything at me.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: How did she master so many different complex Arts anyway?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hey, little Perro. Are you sure you've never studied Originium Arts?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Heyyy, I told you not to move——Lava, quit screwing around!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: All right, all right. My bad. Whatever.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ah, sorry, Miss Perro, just a little longer.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Whew. And that should be it.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Now, Miss Perro, we're pretty much done. Rinse your mouth with this glass of water, and be sure to spit it out. Don't swallow.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You were the first one in the squad to give her something nice to eat.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What's that got to do with anything?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: After starving for that long, she shouldn't be consuming much sugar, from a nutritional standpoint. But she really needs to supplement pretty much everything at this point.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You snuck off and bought a bunch of candy.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Only later realizing you'd spent all your money.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Or when we were bringing Miss Perro back, everyone was worried she'd run off.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Only you were brave enough to try to communicate with her, building the trust we needed to take off her shackles.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And once we learned she liked honey biscuits, it was you, among the five of us, who worked the hardest to make the best ones.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Your big sister is very proud of you.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Come on, don't talk about this stuff in front of her!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I- I just did what I had to do.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But it's so sweet. No need to hide it. Hehe.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So, um, the, like, oral exam, that's the last part, right?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And then, um, what happens to her?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The operators responsible for that are still talking over her case. Orchid said she'd have someone tell us in the afternoon.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Anyway, after a busy morning and all those examinations, it's time to find a place for Miss Perro to——

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Hibiscus, Lava! Are you still not done checking out Miss Perro? If we don't leave now, we'll miss Dobermann's training! I'm going on ahead!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I thought you said got us out of Dobermann's class!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I, er, I might have forgot...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Why didn't you say so earlier?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: All I could think about at the time was helping Miss Perro with her checkup...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Let's go pick out a pair of coffins.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Okay, how about we take little Perro out now and give her to the first person who comes along? I just hope we can find them again after training.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Let's see you come up with one!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'm not running laps around the bridge again.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And I bet you don't want to memorize anatomy textbooks while doing jumping jacks either.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Okay, fine. We'll do it your way.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'll get her weapons. You deal with her.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: B- but what about her mouthwash——

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Can you take care of this girl for a bit? We'll come get her right after training.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: These honey biscuits are her favorite. If she gets cranky, just give Miss Perro one of these.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And don't let her have her weapons just yet.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'm sorry, Miss Perro. We'll be right back!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Aahhh! Only three minutes! She's gonna kill us!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Just take the biscuits. Eat them whenever.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You want me to carry your weapons?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Come on. My workshop is this way.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Come on in. Have a seat.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: If the forge gets too hot, you can go behind the partition.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'm Rhodes Island's blacksmith. Codename Vulcan.
Can Vulcan check my weapons for me?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I am not authorized to perform maintenance on unregistered weapons.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: But there's no harm in just taking a look.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Can I see that axe you're holding?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (This is definitely Minoan craftsmanship. Brings back memories.)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (But it's been wiped down surprisingly clean. You're doing what little maintenance you can, at least.)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (The construction is solid. Doesn't look like it's too damaged. It would be like new after some basic touches.)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (Oddly, no chipping, no warping of the blade. Pretty low temperature steel.)

steps.name: Vulcan.
steps.text: (It's familiar... where have I seen smithing like this before...?)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (Whatever. She can call me that if she wants.)
On the axe, near the grip,
I wanted to go to Minos, but it's a long walk.
No one I met could tell me my name. They could only tell me it's Minoan.
Since Vulcan is a Minoan, you must know how to read it!
Can you read it to me?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (Good thing, it hasn't completely rubbed away.)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (Maybe I should give her a little nudge...)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: People usually have two names, don't they?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Like Lava has a different name when her sister calls her.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not very good at naming things...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan is a blacksmith. Blacksmiths are good people. And good people are good at naming.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Let me think for a moment.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (But I only know how to name weapons. What should I do?)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (No, no, no. She's not a weapon. I need another scheme.)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (Well, there's a pretty easy way out of this... might as well take it.)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Thank you so much, Vulcan, ma'am!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Don't be scared, Kay, it's just someone looking for me. No bad guys here.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: There's no bad guys at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: If you're scared, you can go behind the partition.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Hello, Vulcan, I'm an operator with the logistics department. I've come to relay the decision regarding the little Perro girl who was brought to Rhodes Island yesterday.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Operator Hibiscus said she entrusted the Perro girl to you. Is she still with you?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Don't call me Perro girl. My name is Ceobe.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Now then, we have been over the details surrounding your rescue, our determination is as follows. Please listen carefully.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Due to the circumstances surrounding your arrival, your personal freedom had been temporarily restricted.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: We apologize for that. But from this point on, you will enjoy the right to free movement, effective immediately.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Am I not being sufficiently clear?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I think she may not be getting some of the legalese here.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Just give me the documents. I'll make sure she gets it.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: That would be a big help.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Why were you out on your own back there?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I wanted to go to Minos.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: But I think I went the wrong way.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: According to information provided by the Leithanian branch, she traveled from Bolívar all the way to the Trijunction of the East, where she then turned back.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: At that point, she made a large arc across the north, until finally being rescued by our people in Leithanien.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: If you made it to Minos, what were you going to do?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I haven't thought that far ahead yet.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Operator Vulcan, please inform her of the situation and let her make her decision.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: So what would you want to do after that?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I... I want to eat until I'm full every day.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I want to spend half the day in a hot bath, and then wrap myself in a warm blanket.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: And lay there until I'm hungry again.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: And I want a big house where I can keep all my treasures.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Carrying them around all day is kind of hard.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: If there was a place where you could eat and drink and have a house to sleep in, would you want to stay there?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: But most of the time, you have to think a lot, and you have to fight a lot of bad guys, and sometimes you might not sleep for days. Even then, would you want to stay there?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I'm not very good with thinking...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan, ma'am, are you talking about being a hero?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Heh. Yes. I'm talking about being a hero.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I want to eat, and be a hero.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: What more could I ever want?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: She's made up her mind, please take care of her paperwork.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: If she needs a sponsor, you can put down my name.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: If you insist, I have nothing more to say.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I'll prepare a follow-up test for Ceobe at once.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: But please be aware that you will need to attach the appropriate guarantees——

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Well, I'll take my leave then.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You still have a lot to learn, a lot of fights to fight.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It'll be a lot of work.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Get some rest while you still can.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: You want a honey biscuit? Lava baked them. They're good.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (The crust isn't crispy enough, and something's wrong with the honey seasoning.)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (Other than that, it tastes exactly like the ones in Minos.)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: A biscuit like this should be eaten fresh out of the oven.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Put some jam on it, and pair it with a cup of tea.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'll ask Matterhorn next door to make some for you, when I get a chance.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: He's great at making these sorts of things.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You're going to be subjected to a lot of testing over the next few days.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: We'll have to fix you up a bit, and your weapons too.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Y- you'll fix them for me?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It's a blacksmith's duty to make sure a weapon meets its wielder's needs.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Just tell me what you need.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Um, I want all my treasures to look as good as the weapons here in your house.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: And, um, I want the other weapons to be the same color as my axe.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I might be done in time for you to surprise Hibiscus and Lava.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Bring your weapons. Let's get started.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Little Perro is gonna be okay, right Hibiscus?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: She's so good at fighting, and Vulcan is so nice. What could go wrong?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Anyway, I know she won't do anything bad.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But I'm more worried about that logistics operator who showed up in the middle of training. He had a pretty big file with him.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: In my experience, your 'bad feelings' usually signal good things.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I hope you're right... oh, we're here.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's Lava. We're here to see the little Pe——Miss Perro.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Ah, Lava and Hibiscus! You're here!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Wh- what happened to your weapons?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Don't call me Miss Perro anymore. Call me Ceobe.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: I think you know why I asked you here today.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: She doesn't take orders. She just throws her weapons around and makes a scene.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: How do you think she did?

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: She made a mess of herself and failed a bunch of tests. But her personal character and potential qualify her to be an operator.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: And, taking into account the opinions of several of her proctors, the other details are less important.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The Doctor is never wrong about anyone.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Can I get a reason now?

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Normally, the operator assessment process is initiated by the individual herself.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: We typically look poorly on situations where an individual has the decision made for her. Especially when there is no guardian or relative involved.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Ah well, it's not that big a deal. Rules were made to be broken.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Just give me a reason. I have to pass something upstairs.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: A girl who likes weapons can't be bad.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: I'm gonna need a little more than that. A few more sentences or there's no way I can finish this report.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'm a blacksmith. I don't know people. But I do know weapons.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: If you have someone with absolutely no knowledge of weapon maintenance and upkeep,

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: her weapons are going to get damaged after a long period of use.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Still, she did her best to keep her equipment in good shape, to the best of her abilities.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: That was enough for me to affirm her talent and potential.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: How can you be sure she doesn't know weapon maintenance?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: She can't use a whetstone, she doesn't know her oils. That's long before we start talking about any rules or scientific principles.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The only thing she knows how to do is polish her weapons. And she's good at that.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You know better than me what has to go on a resume.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: She's a Bolívarian, traveled the whole world looking for Minos, and never quite found it.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: All I can say is her spirit is commendable.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It's always good to have faith.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: You usually don't pay much attention to people.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: This Ceobe, is she that special?

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: What is it about her that caught your attention?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Her name was carved into that axe.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Minos isn't Higashi. We don't just tape our names onto weapons in case we lose them.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: If your name is on a weapon, it means something big.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: But that technique, I know I've seen it somewhere...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I want to help her solve the mystery of that weapon.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Then, maybe someday, she'll come back and solve something for me.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I guess you could say I'm just a selfish blacksmith.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Sorry to bother you. Go get some rest.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: No need. I'm just doing my job here.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Don't thank me either. Next time you're up for a drink, come by while I'm on. I've got a new mix, I'm calling it 'Kazimierz Fury.' Give it a try sometime?

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: That's why I say HR ain't easy.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Kids these days don't know how to write a proper CV.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: It takes a good chat to dig up all the juicy stuff hidden down there.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: It's all mysteries wrapped up in enigmas.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Damn it, I'm an HR director, not a detective!

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: (Short, but passionate words in a Victorian dialect)

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Director.... we're ready to interview the new operator. If you would.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: I see. By the way, here's Ceobe's contract, all signed and notarized. File it for me and then send someone to inform the operator of her formal onboarding.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Just a moment. Be sure operator Vulcan is there for that. She may be needed to explain some of the formal terms and conditions.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Okay, enough chatter, back to work.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Another one who can't write a CV worth a damn.

steps.name: HR Director
steps.text: Looks like I'm in for another long evening.
